title: Pre-Analysis — Twenty-Two Minute Oxygen Generator Effectivity Extension
abstract: Closed re-analysis of the longer duration oxygen generator standard, run to extend the retrofit to a fourth operator and to a second cabin layout, covering the hose run length and the mixed installation prohibition.

sections.objective: Extend the retrofit effectivity of the twenty-two minute generator to a fourth operator flying a second cabin layout, and establish whether the hose set and the row list published for the first layout still apply.
sections.findings_summary: Three items were confirmed and the extension was approved. The substantive finding concerned the hose run: the outboard hose is fitted at every second row where the run is longest, and the row list published with the change was built from the first cabin layout. In the second layout the galley position moves and two rows that need the longer hose are not on the list. Installing the shorter hose there would give a flow at the start of the sequence below the acceptance figure, and nothing in the installation would show it. The second finding was that the mixed installation prohibition is stated in the modification and in the bulletin but not in the maintenance task, which is the document a technician actually has open. The third was a minor illustrated part list note.
sections.next_steps: Publish a row list per cabin layout rather than one list, and make the layout an input to the kit order. Add the mixed installation prohibition to the removal task as a warning. Amend the figure note. Release the extension to the fourth operator.

similarity_seeds: hose length and flow at the start of the oxygen sequence in a different cabin layout

tasks.title: Compare the row list against the second cabin layout
Trace where the mixed installation prohibition is stated

expected_findings.rationale: The row list for the outboard hose was built from the first cabin layout. In the second layout the galley position moves and two rows that need the longer hose are not on the list; the shorter hose there would give a start-of-sequence flow below the acceptance figure with no visible symptom.
expected_findings.resolution: Row list published per cabin layout and the layout made an input to the kit order.

expected_findings.rationale: The prohibition on a mixed installation within one service unit is stated in the modification and in the bulletin but not in the removal task, which is the document the technician has open at the aircraft.
expected_findings.resolution: Warning added to the removal task.

expected_findings.rationale: The figure note about the row list did not say that the list is layout dependent, which is exactly the error this analysis found.

expected_non_findings.reason: Returned on the cabin zones because both changes open the same ceiling area. The overhead stowage change does not touch the passenger service units, the generator cradle or the hose run, and the two are only ever done at the same visit for convenience.

type_data.conclusion: Extension approved with a per-layout row list. The hose length finding would not have shown itself in service until it was needed.
